title: Remote access
pageDesc: Use Flint on this computer from your phone, while it runs here.
enableDesc: Paired phones can use Flint on this computer while it runs. Off by default.
reachableDesc: Flint listens only on the network you pick here.
noPhoneApp: This copy of Flint is missing the phone app's files, so phones see a page saying it is not included. Reinstall Flint, and check that an older copy is not the one running. Flint looked in:
customHostDesc: Optional. A name of your own that points at this computer, like flint.example.com. The pairing link uses it instead of the address. With HTTPS, the certificate must cover it.
fingerprintDesc: Check that your phone shows the same SHA-256 fingerprint the first time it connects.
allowApprovalsDesc: Answer tool-approval prompts from a paired phone.
allowAlwaysDesc: Lets a phone grant a standing permission. Off by default; the computer enforces it.
pairHint: Open this exact link on the phone you want to connect. You will still confirm the matching number on this computer.
pairCopyFailed: Could not copy the pairing link. Select the link below and copy it manually.
pairScan: Scan this code with your phone's camera, then check that the number on your phone matches.
confirmDesc: Only confirm if your phone shows this number:
